item.title: Temporary closure of Icomm Drive, Market Street South intersection begins March 4
item.description: Starting March 4, the intersection at Icomm Drive and Market Street South will be closed to complete underground infrastructure work related to the ongoing downtown revitalization project. Crews will be adjusting the alignment of the trunk sanitary sewer and replacing an existing watermain to work around old infrastructure buried beneath the intersection, said a notice from the City of Brantford. “Because of the depth and complexity […]

item.title: Brant OPP probe historic incidents of assault; break-in at gas station
item.description: Brant resident charged with spousal assault A 39-year-old Brant County resident has been charged following an intimate partner violence investigation. Brant County OPP was called to a residence just before 7 p.m. on Thursday, February 26, regarding a report of several historic incidents of intimate partner violence. item.title: Parker's Project leader calls for compassion following woman's arrest in 20-year-old cold case
item.description: The woman who leads Parker's Project hopes the community will go forward with compassion and support following the arrest of a woman in connection with the death of a newborn more than 20 years ago.

item.title: Workers at Brantford's Slacan Industries on strike after contract talks break down
item.description: About 116 workers at Brantford’s Slacan Industries, members of the United Steelworkers (USW) Local 3505, are on strike after an overwhelming rejection of the employer’s contract offer. Bob Yates, area coordinator for the union, said collective agreement negotiations had been ongoing with the company since mid-January. item.title: Police report second big downtown drug seizure in Brantford this week
item.description: On Friday, six people were arrested and drugs worth more than $70,000 seized at a downtown residence by Brantford's Emergency Response Team.
